title: ToeVla: archived accessibility screenings of places in Flanders (2010s)
description: Archive of the former ToeVla database (Toegankelijk Vlaanderen), taken offline by its owner and republished read-only for this demonstrator. About 7,600 places ('inrichtingen') in Flanders and Brussels: youth hostels, restaurants and cafes, hotels, holiday homes, guest rooms, visitor farms, congress venues, town halls, community centres, reserved parking spaces and more. Per place: address, website, the screening dossiers with date and screening organisation (Inter, ATO, Enter, the provincial accessibility offices), photos, and a basic screening with coded Dutch fields. About half of the dossiers also have a detailed on-site screening: measured and checked answers per room and element (entrance, doors, lifts, toilets, parking, signage), with a written summary, in Dutch. Data dates from about 2010 to 2015, a few records to 2020: check that a place still looks the same before relying on it. Flow: listInrichtingen (q = name, municipality, postal code or street) for the id; getInrichtingAccessibility for an outline of the newest dossier; then the same call with section=<code> (e.g. WC, INK, PGEL, ALGEM for the summary) for the answers. getInrichting lists photo URLs; prefix them with the endpoint URL to get links that open without login.

publisher.name: Toerisme Vlaanderen (original data); archive hosted by the demonstrator team

licence_note: No licence published. Toerisme Vlaanderen asked for this integration; terms for reuse outside the demonstrator still to be confirmed.

assessment.note: On-site screenings by Inter, its offices and partner organisations (screenedBy and receivedAt per dossier in getInrichtingAccessibility), mostly 2010-2015. Old: name the date and check the web for the current state.
